source_title: How Retailers Can Reinvent the Digital Flywheel for Agentic Commerce
business_context: BCG survey of 50 leading global retailers and 100 global brands explores preparedness for agentic shopping. Exhibit 4 refers to retailer planned actions; exact item-level denominators are not disclosed in accessible text.
key_message: AI 쇼핑 에이전트 대응에서 제품 데이터 보강 계획(67%)이 실시간 재고·가용성 제공 계획(58%)을 9%p 앞서므로, 데이터 품질과 실시간 실행 정보를 함께 투자 과제로 관리해야 한다.

data_spec.uncertainty_notes: Original labelled values are approximations when stated as about/approximately; no pixel digitization or invented precision.

data_recipe: retailer_id; geography; store_type; planned_data_enrichment_2y(boolean); planned_live_availability_2y(boolean); survey_weight(optional). Deduplicate respondents; confirm inclusion/exclusion and per-item missingness; compute each indicator as weighted or unweighted positive responses over its valid item denominator ×100; preserve independently estimated denominators and disclose n. Put category/value/period in the plotting table. Do not infer conversion 58/67.
message_conditions: The 9pp difference is valid only if the two percentages have comparable denominators/question scopes, which require confirmation. If the values invert, rewrite the title. A stated plan cannot establish implementation, causality, ROI, or marketplace readiness.
design_moves: 공통 가로축을 사용하고 원문이 명시한 값을 직접 라벨로 표기
